caseStudies.title: Apple Seasonal Search
caseStudies.headline: From seasonal demand to enterprise execution.
caseStudies.deck: Connected research, technical requirements and stakeholder alignment across Apple’s Americas seasonal commerce program.
caseStudies.heroAlt: Public Apple holiday-season page illustrating seasonal commerce
caseStudies.heroCaption: Public Apple seasonal surface, used as representative context.

chapters.heading: Start with the seasonal customer need.
paragraphs: Holiday gifting, Mother’s Day, back-to-school and education bring different customer questions and tight execution windows. Across the Americas, the search program also had to work across markets, languages and teams.
I translated seasonal demand into coordinated search requirements, connecting the opportunity to the people responsible for commerce, content and engineering.

chapters.heading: Make the requirements actionable.
paragraphs: The work connected demand research, hreflang and locale architecture, JavaScript rendering and indexation checks, and evergreen content strategy. Those disciplines informed a program that engineering, design, marketing and regional stakeholders could act on.
Strategy readouts reached audiences of more than 60 stakeholders. They supported engineering roadmap prioritization and brought AI search considerations into longer-term planning.

chapters.heading: Carry search into the operating rhythm.
paragraphs: The contribution was a repeatable execution path for search across seasonal planning and launch. It required technical fluency, a clear business case and the ability to align teams without direct reporting authority.

caseStudies.takeaway: A useful search recommendation needs an owner, an execution path and a reason to make the roadmap.
caseStudies.sourceNote: Responsibilities and scale are from approved career and portfolio records. No unpublished Apple performance lift or global-program ownership is asserted.

caseStudies.title: SFC Surf School
caseStudies.headline: Turn local knowledge into something people can explore.
caseStudies.deck: A connected engagement across research, website and content architecture, interactive design, engineering and performance reporting.
caseStudies.heroAlt: Ten-break SFC surf explorer on a real Waikīkī aerial
caseStudies.heroCaption: Production release review, September 10, 2026. Aerial: USDA-FSA NAIP, January 27, 2022, via NOAA Digital Coast.
caseStudies.metricInterpretation: Search growth reflects the earlier website work. The September 10 map launch came after the measured period.

chapters.heading: Find the useful opening.
paragraphs: SFC competes in a busy destination market. Its local knowledge and teaching approach needed to become useful information before a visitor booked.

I mapped competitors through search visibility, crawled 973 pages across ten businesses and combined desktop/mobile keyword research with a concrete publishing plan. The audit also identified 38 completed pages that had not been published.

chapters.heading: Build a product around the place.
paragraphs: The South Shore guide became a ten-break explorer. A visitor can select a reef, see footage from that break, follow the original video source, check conditions and open its dedicated guide.

I replaced an inaccurate generated map with a real, georeferenced NAIP aerial and incorporated the owner’s placement corrections. Readable controls, keyboard selection and lighter preview images made the experience usable across desktop and mobile.

chapters.heading: Deliver the surrounding system.
paragraphs: Ten linked break articles, lesson-planning content, campaign planning and source-backed reporting supported the feature. The production release brought the sitemap to 63 indexable pages and passed the route and interaction checks.
Staging parity, exact-commit promotion and rollback verification were part of delivery. The goal was a better working business website, not a standalone demonstration.

chapters.heading: Show what changed, and when.
paragraphs: Search Console recorded 54 clicks and 1,652 impressions for August 12–September 8, up from five clicks and 470 impressions in the preceding 28-day period.
The new explorer launched September 10. Reporting separates that delivery from the earlier search gains, and search engagement from confirmed bookings.

caseStudies.takeaway: The opportunity became a connected piece of work: research, content, interface, implementation and evidence.
caseStudies.sourceNote: Google Search Console comparison and production-release records, reviewed September 10, 2026. Exact reef placement combines geographic references and owner review; recorded footage is not live conditions.
